q: Which bridge crew does Kaladin lead in Sadeas's army?
explain: Bridge Four began as the unluckiest crew on the Shattered Plains before Kaladin turned it around.

q: What is the name of the Cryptic bonded to Shallan?
explain: Pattern hums when pleased and makes Shallan a Lightweaver.

q: When are spheres left out to be infused with Stormlight?
explain: Rosharans hang their spheres outside during highstorms so the gems absorb fresh Stormlight.

q: Which younger brother did Kaladin fail to protect in Amaram's army?
explain: Tien's death haunts Kaladin, who had joined the army to keep him safe.

q: Which of Kaladin's bridgemen is a Horneater who cooks for the crew?
explain: Rock's stew helps bind the bridgemen together, and as a Horneater he can see spren others cannot.

q: Who travels to Kharbranth hoping to become Jasnah Kholin's ward?
explain: Shallan secretly planned to steal Jasnah's Soulcaster to save her family.

q: Which order of Knights Radiant does Kaladin belong to?
explain: Windrunners bond honorspren and swear to protect those who cannot protect themselves.

q: Which order of Knights Radiant does Dalinar Kholin join?
explain: Dalinar is bonded to the Stormfather, one of the three great spren tied to the Bondsmiths.

q: Which of Shallan's personas is a streetwise spy?
explain: Veil wears a white coat and hat and works with the Ghostbloods.

q: What is the name of Lift's cultivationspren?
explain: Wyndle was a renowned gardener of chairs in Shadesmar before he was asked to bond Lift.

q: Which greatshell do the Alethi hunt on the Shattered Plains for its gemheart?
explain: Winning gemhearts from chasmfiends drives the rivalry between the highprinces.

q: Who assassinated King Gavilar Kholin?
explain: Szeth, the Assassin in White, was sent by the Parshendi on the night of the treaty feast.

q: Complete the First Ideal: "Life before death, strength before weakness, journey before..."
explain: The First Ideal is shared by every order of the Knights Radiant.

q: Which former bridgeman from Kaladin's crew kills King Elhokar?
explain: Moash kills Elhokar during the fall of Kholinar, betraying Kaladin.

q: What color is the lightning of the Everstorm?
explain: The Everstorm blows in the opposite direction to the highstorms.

q: Which hand do Vorin women keep covered as their safehand?
explain: Exposing the safehand is considered as improper as going out in public undressed.

q: How many orders of Knights Radiant were there?
explain: Each order was linked to one of the ten Heralds.

q: What is the ancient city of the Knights Radiant, rediscovered by Shallan?
explain: Urithiru is a vast tower reached through Oathgates.

q: In Wind and Truth, to which land does Kaladin travel with Szeth?
explain: Kaladin goes to help Szeth confront the corruption in his homeland.

q: What do the Alethi call the people they fight on the Shattered Plains?
explain: The Parshendi grow carapace armor and sing as they go into battle.

q: Which of Shallan's brothers was the Shardbearer Kaladin killed in Amaram's army?
explain: Helaran bore a Shardblade and Shardplate when Kaladin killed him while saving Amaram.

q: What is the name of Jasnah Kholin's inkspren?
explain: Ivory's bond makes Jasnah an Elsecaller, letting her travel into Shadesmar.

q: Which Radiant order does Renarin Kholin join?
explain: Renarin's spren Glys was corrupted by the Unmade Sja-anat, letting him see the future.

q: Which spren does Navani Kholin bond?
explain: The Sibling is the spren of Urithiru and had gone unbonded for millennia before Navani.

q: Which Unmade is the source of the Thrill felt by Alethi warriors?
explain: Nergaoul fed the bloodlust of the armies at the Battle of Thaylen Field.

q: Which Herald did not abandon the Oathpact at Aharietiam?
explain: Talenel endured torture in Damnation alone for millennia.

q: In which Tashikki city does Edgedancer take place?
explain: In Yeddaw, Lift befriends Stump, a woman who runs an orphanage.

q: What kind of creature is Chiri-Chiri, Rysn's pet?
explain: Larkins feed on Investiture, and Chiri-Chiri's illness drives Rysn's voyage.

q: Kaladin speaks his Third Ideal while protecting which man he hates?
explain: The Third Ideal is: I will protect even those I hate, so long as it is right.

q: Which fabrial lets people write to each other across great distances?
explain: A spanreed is made of two pens holding the halves of a split gemstone.

q: Which gemstone do Soulcasters use to turn things into grain and food?
explain: This makes emerald broams the most valuable spheres.

q: Which form does Eshonai adopt before the Everstorm is summoned?
explain: Stormform is a form of power that lets its bearers channel lightning.

q: What is the name of Dalinar's late wife, erased from his memory?
explain: Dalinar asked the Nightwatcher to take away his pain, and lost his memories of her.

q: Which substance is Teft secretly addicted to?
explain: Teft's family belonged to the Envisagers, a cult hoping to bring back the Radiants.

q: What does Venli call the Reacher spren she bonds?
explain: Timbre communicates by pulsing to the rhythms and makes Venli a Willshaper.

q: Who becomes the Vessel of Odium at the end of Rhythm of War?
explain: Taravangian kills the previous Vessel and takes up the Shard himself.

q: Over how many days does the main story of Wind and Truth unfold?
explain: The days count down to the contest of champions agreed with Odium.

q: What are the flying Fused called?
explain: Heavenly Ones such as Leshwi glide on the wind using Voidlight.

q: Instead of Ideals, what must Lightweavers speak to progress?
explain: Shallan's Truths force her to admit painful facts about her past.

q: Which two Surges do Windrunners command?
explain: Kaladin uses Gravitation for Lashings and Adhesion to stick objects together.

q: Which Unmade is known as the Midnight Mother?
explain: Re-Shephir lurked in the tower until Shallan drove her away.

q: Szeth's Honorblade originally belonged to which Herald?
explain: The Shin kept the Honorblades abandoned by the Heralds at Aharietiam.

q: Which Herald is the patron of the Truthwatchers?
explain: Pailiah, also called Pali, is the Herald of the Truthwatchers, associated with the divine attributes Learned and Giving.

q: Which ancient Alethi conqueror is known as the Sunmaker?
explain: The Sunmaker's vast empire fell apart soon after his death.

q: Which Unmade did the Bondsmith Melishi trap in a perfect gem?
explain: Her imprisonment is linked to the singers losing their forms and becoming parshmen.

q: Warlight is created by combining Stormlight with what?
explain: Navani and Raboniel studied warlight together during the occupation of Urithiru.

q: Which forbidden Aimian city is the goal of Rysn's expedition in Dawnshard?
explain: Akinah is guarded by the Sleepless, who keep its secrets hidden.

q: Which Fused is known as the Lady of Wishes?
explain: Raboniel organized the Fused occupation of Urithiru.

q: In Wind and Truth, which besieged capital does Adolin help defend?
explain: Adolin fights alongside Emperor Yanagawn's forces without any Radiant powers.

q: In Dawnshard, which Windrunner swears his Third Ideal to protect Lopen?
explain: Huio is a Herdazian Windrunner sent with Lopen to guard Rysn on the voyage.

q: What is the name of Kaladin's mother?
explain: Hesina is married to Lirin, the surgeon of Hearthstone.

q: Which order of Knights Radiant prefers to be called the Releasers?
explain: Malata learns from her ashspren Spark that the order dislikes the name Dustbringers.

q: Which kind of spren forms the Nahel bond with Stonewards?
explain: Peakspren look like stone and can hide inside real rocks.

q: Which con artist trains Shallan in deception until Shallan kills her?
explain: Tyn was working for the Ghostbloods and had been sent to kill Jasnah.

q: Who is Rysn's babsk, the Thaylen merchant who trains her?
explain: Rysn travels with Vstim as his apprentice, learning the art of trade.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-4

q: In which region does Ishikk, the fisherman of the Way of Kings interludes, live?
explain: Ishikk guides foreigners searching for a man across the shallow waters of the Purelake.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-1

q: What is the name of the spren of Adolin's Shardblade?
explain: Maya is a deadeye whom Adolin's care slowly brings back to awareness.

q: What do Taravangian and his conspirators call the plan he wrote on his day of genius?
explain: Taravangian wrote the Diagram on a single day of extraordinary intelligence.

q: Which ardent in Kharbranth, secretly a Ghostblood agent, courted Shallan?
explain: Kabsal tried to poison Jasnah with bread, but died when Jasnah Soulcast the antidote, believing it was the poison.
source: The Way of Kings; Words of Radiance

q: How many chips of the same gem are worth one mark?
explain: Four marks make a broam, so a broam is worth twenty chips.

q: In the Ars Arcanum's table of the Ten Essences, which Essence corresponds to Jezrien and the sapphire?
explain: Zephyr is listed as translucent gas or air, with inhalation as its body focus.
source: The Way of Kings, Ars Arcanum

q: Which Herald is associated with the divine attributes Brave and Obedient?
explain: Chanarach is linked to the number Chach, the ruby and the Essence Spark.
source: The Way of Kings, Ars Arcanum

q: According to the Ars Arcanum, which gemstone is associated with the Herald Talenel?
explain: Talenel's Essence is Talus, and his divine attributes are Dependable and Resourceful.
source: The Way of Kings, Ars Arcanum

q: Which Third Ideal of the Edgedancers does Lift swear in Edgedancer?
a: I will listen to those who have been ignored
wrong: I will remember those who have been forgotten
I will protect those who cannot protect themselves
I will seek justice and let it guide me
explain: Lift swears it while facing Nale, after earlier swearing to remember the forgotten.

q: Which of Kaladin's bridgemen, who cannot draw Stormlight, is contacted by the Sibling during the occupation of Urithiru?
explain: The Sibling asks Dabbid to swap a spanreed gem so it can communicate through the spanreed.

q: To which people does Axies the Collector, who catalogs every type of spren, belong?
explain: Axies can alter his own body, and uses this to write research notes on his skin as tattoos.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-5

q: Which kind of spren does the ardent Geranid study on her island in the Reshi Sea?
explain: Geranid discovers that a flamespren stops changing once it has been measured and recorded.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-8

q: What is the trade of Ym, the Surgebinder killed by Nale in a Words of Radiance interlude?
explain: Ym gives shoes to a street boy and heals his infected foot with Stormlight just before Nale arrives.

q: In her Way of Kings interlude, to which land does Rysn travel with her babsk to trade?
explain: Her babsk trades Soulcast scrap metal to the Shin trader Thresh for chickens, cloth and dried meats.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-4

q: On her trading trip in The Way of Kings, which occupation does Rysn learn the Shin hold in the highest esteem?
explain: To Rysn's surprise, soldiers are considered the lowliest of men among the Shin.
source: The Way of Kings, interlude I-4

q: According to the Ars Arcanum, which gemstone is used to create a reverser fabrial?
explain: Reversers are made like conjoiners, which use rubies, but their halves move in opposite directions.

q: Which ancient Silver Kingdom is considered the predecessor of Alethkar?
explain: Alethela was one of the ten Silver Kingdoms, and its lands later became Alethkar.

q: Which of Taravangian's bodyguards helps judge each morning whether the king is fit to make decisions?
explain: Taravangian takes an intelligence test every morning, and Mrall and the stormwardens decide what he may do that day.

q: What is the name of Teft's honorspren?
explain: Unlike most honorspren, Phendorana appears in a human-sized form.

q: What is the name of Huio's honorspren?
explain: Caelinora can manifest as a living Shardhammer.

q: Which ship carries Rysn's expedition in Dawnshard?
explain: Captained by Drlwan, the Wandersail breaches the strange storm surrounding the hidden Aimian city.

q: Selections from which in-world book about the Unmade serve as the epigraphs of Part Four of Oathbringer?
explain: Hessi's controversial claims, such as the Unmade still being alive, were later proved right.

q: Under which name does the Herald Ishar rule Tukar as god-priest?
explain: As Tezim, Ishar wars with Emul over Sesemalex Dar and refuses to join Dalinar's coalition.

q: Which Unmade is the source of the Death Rattles, the prophetic words spoken by the dying?
explain: Taravangian records the Death Rattles of patients in Kharbranth while Moelach lingers near the city.

q: Navani begins cracking the Dawnchant after recognizing words from Dalinar's visions in which text?
explain: The phrase matched a line of Vanrial songs preserved in the Analectics, leading to a wave of Dawnchant translations.
source: The Way of Kings; Words of Radiance

q: In Wind and Truth, which Herald does Dalinar send Kaladin to find, hoping to restore the Oathpact?
explain: Dalinar hopes Ishar, despite his madness, knows how the Oathpact can be restored.

q: At the start of Wind and Truth, to which kingdom does Jasnah go to help its queen defend her capital?
explain: Jasnah travels to Thaylenah to aid Queen Fen as Odium's forces close in on Thaylen City.

q: In Wind and Truth, who leads Bridge Four at the Shattered Plains while Kaladin is away?
explain: With Kaladin gone, Sigzil takes command of the Windrunners of Bridge Four.

q: At the start of Wind and Truth, what new ability does Syl show?
a: She can take on human size
wrong: She can travel far from Kaladin unharmed
explain: In the opening chapters, Syl can appear as large as a person instead of only as a tiny figure.

q: In Wind and Truth, who enters the Spiritual Realm with Dalinar to look for an edge before the contest of champions?
explain: Both Bondsmiths enter together, hoping the Spiritual Realm holds a way to defeat Odium.

q: In Wind and Truth, which mysterious entity calls Kaladin by name and warns him that the worst storm is yet to come?
explain: The Wind asks Kaladin for help and urges him to listen to the Bondsmith.

q: In Wind and Truth, which young child ends up trapped in the Spiritual Realm along with Dalinar?
explain: Gavinor had followed Dalinar, and when the anchors to the Physical Realm were cut he was swept away with him, while Wit protected Lift.

q: In Wind and Truth, where do Shallan, Renarin and Rlain learn that the prison of the Unmade they are hunting is held?
wrong: In the bead ocean of Shadesmar
Inside the crystal pillar of Urithiru
explain: The Unmade was sealed in a flawless heliodor and hidden in the Spiritual Realm long ago.

q: In a Wind and Truth flashback, young Szeth's father offers to move the family's home. What does Szeth choose to move instead?
explain: After the family's sheep uncovers a new stone, Szeth chooses to move it, sensing that his family had hoped he would.

q: What is the name of Szeth's older sister, who appears in Wind and Truth?
explain: Elid-daughter-Zeenid is Szeth's older sister and, like him, an Honorbearer.

q: In Wind and Truth, the Stone Shaman Rit bears which Herald's Honorblade?
explain: The Stoneward monastery took Taln's Honorblade, and Rit fought Szeth there as its Honorbearer.

q: In Wind and Truth, which Herald admits to Shallan that he helped capture the Unmade she is hunting?
explain: Kalak was part of the team that captured that Unmade long ago, but is overwhelmed by the memory and flees.

q: In Wind and Truth, which Fused ambushes Adolin and Shallan in Shadesmar and later faces Adolin again in the defense of Azimir?
explain: Abidi, one of the finest Fused duelists, fights with aluminum-lined maces.

q: In Wind and Truth, which moment of history does Dalinar reach in the Spiritual Realm, using a stone from Wit as his anchor?
a: The arrival of humans on Roshar
explain: Wit had picked the stone out himself before the migration, and it carried Dalinar to the arrival of the first humans.

q: In Wind and Truth, what have the Honorbearers of the Stone Shamans been turned into, letting them come back after being killed?
explain: Ishar made them able to take a new body after dying, so Szeth needs Nightblood to end them for good.

q: In Wind and Truth, who is the Commandant Supreme of the Azish Imperial Guard?
explain: Zarb Kushkam leads the Azish forces guarding the Oathgate, while his son Gezamal leads the emperor's honor guard.

q: In Wind and Truth, how do the Azish plan to stop the enemy from using their Oathgate's control room?
a: By flooding it and Soulcasting the water into bronze
wrong: By lining its walls with aluminum
explain: A control room filled with solid metal would be useless to Odium's forces.

q: In Szeth's Wind and Truth flashbacks, which instrument does his older sister play while he dances?
explain: Young Szeth dances in wide circles to the sound of his sister's flute.

q: In Wind and Truth, which Surge does the Stone Shaman Rit use to make the monastery floor flow and attack Szeth?
explain: Rit melts the stone floor, mural and all, and wields it against Szeth.

q: How many interludes does Wind and Truth contain?
explain: Wind and Truth has eighteen interludes, numbered I-1 to I-18.
